extraMeanings.en: to officially give or allow someone something
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The committee granted her permission to leave early.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Komite ona erken ayrılma izni verdi.

extraMeanings.en: very serious and worrying
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The doctors said his condition was grave.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Doktorlar durumunun vahim olduğunu söyledi.

extraMeanings.en: the seriousness or importance of something
extraMeanings.exampleEn: He did not seem to understand the gravity of the situation.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Durumun ciddiyetini anlamış gibi görünmüyordu.

extraMeanings.en: to cook food on a grill
extraMeanings.exampleEn: We grilled some chicken and vegetables for dinner.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Akşam yemeği için biraz tavuk ve sebze ızgara yaptık.

extraMeanings.en: to question someone closely and persistently
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The reporters grilled the minister about the scandal.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Muhabirler bakanı skandal hakkında sıkıştırdı.

extraMeanings.en: to clean and care for an animal's coat
extraMeanings.exampleEn: She grooms her horse every morning.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Her sabah atını tımar eder.

extraMeanings.en: to prepare someone for a particular job or position
extraMeanings.exampleEn: He was being groomed to take over the company.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Şirketi devralmak için yetiştiriliyordu.

extraMeanings.en: to promise that something will happen or be done
extraMeanings.exampleEn: I can guarantee that you will love this book.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Bu kitabı seveceğinize garanti veririm.

extraMeanings.en: to give an answer without being sure it is correct
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Can you guess how old I am?
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Kaç yaşında olduğumu tahmin edebilir misin?

extraMeanings.en: to lead or show someone the way
extraMeanings.exampleEn: She guided us through the old part of the city.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Bizi şehrin eski kısmında gezdirdi.

extraMeanings.en: to hit something with a hammer
extraMeanings.exampleEn: He hammered the nail into the wall.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Çiviyi duvara çaktı.

extraMeanings.en: one of two equal parts of something
extraMeanings.exampleEn: She gave me half of her sandwich.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Sandviçinin yarısını bana verdi.

extraMeanings.en: to keep a feeling or thought in your mind for a long time
extraMeanings.exampleEn: She still harbors resentment toward her old boss.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Eski patronuna hâlâ kızgınlık besliyor.

extraMeanings.en: to keep a feeling or thought in your mind for a long time
extraMeanings.exampleEn: He harboured a secret hope of becoming an actor.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Aktör olma gizli bir umudu içinde taşıyordu.

extraMeanings.en: to control and use the force or power of something
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Scientists are looking for ways to harness solar energy.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Bilim insanları güneş enerjisinden yararlanmanın yollarını arıyor.

extraMeanings.en: to come out of an egg, or to cause a young bird to do so
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The chicks hatched early in the morning.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Civcivler sabahın erken saatinde yumurtadan çıktı.

extraMeanings.en: to keep returning to someone's mind in a troubling way; (of a ghost) to visit a place
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The memory of the accident still haunts her.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Kaza anısı hâlâ onu rahat bırakmıyor.

extraMeanings.en: to risk saying something that may be wrong
extraMeanings.exampleEn: I'd hazard a guess that she is about forty.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Kırk yaşlarında olduğunu tahmin etme cesaretini gösterirdim.

extraMeanings.en: the direction in which someone or something is moving
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The ship changed its heading to avoid the storm.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Gemi fırtınadan kaçınmak için rotasını değiştirdi.

extraMeanings.en: the best or most exciting part of something
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Meeting the president was the highlight of the trip.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Cumhurbaşkanıyla tanışmak gezinin en unutulmaz anıydı.

extraMeanings.en: to strike someone or something with force
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The car hit a tree and stopped.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Araba bir ağaca çarpıp durdu.

extraMeanings.en: very fashionable and up to date
extraMeanings.exampleEn: They opened a hip new café downtown.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Şehir merkezinde havalı, yeni bir kafe açtılar.

extraMeanings.en: important in history; likely to be remembered
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The signing of the treaty was a historic moment.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Anlaşmanın imzalanması tarihî bir andı.

extraMeanings.en: a device in a vehicle used to make a warning sound
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The driver honked the horn angrily.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Sürücü öfkeyle kornaya bastı.

extraMeanings.en: to jump on one foot or move in short jumps
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The rabbit hopped across the garden.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Tavşan bahçenin öbür ucuna zıplayarak gitti.

extraMeanings.en: a low continuous sound
extraMeanings.exampleEn: You could hear the hum of the machines from outside.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Makinelerin uğultusu dışarıdan duyuluyordu.

extraMeanings.en: to chase and kill animals, or to search for something
extraMeanings.exampleEn: They hunt for bargains at the market every weekend.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Her hafta sonu pazarda ucuz mal ararlar.

extraMeanings.en: to cause pain or injury to someone
extraMeanings.exampleEn: My back hurts after sitting all day.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Bütün gün oturmaktan sırtım ağrıyor.

extraMeanings.en: a strong desire or need for something
extraMeanings.exampleEn: She has a hunger for success.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Başarıya karşı büyük bir açlığı var.

extraMeanings.en: to make a problem or bad feeling end
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Time helped to heal the rift between them.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Zaman, aralarındaki kırgınlığı onarmaya yardım etti.

extraMeanings.en: to be unwilling to do something because of doubt
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Don't hesitate to call me if you need help.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Yardıma ihtiyacın olursa beni aramaktan çekinme.

extraMeanings.en: the raised part on the bottom back of a shoe
extraMeanings.exampleEn: She wore shoes with very high heels.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Çok yüksek topuklu ayakkabılar giymişti.

extraMeanings.en: to make something clearer or easier to understand
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The professor's example helped to illuminate the theory.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Profesörün örneği teoriyi anlaşılır kılmaya yardımcı oldu.

extraMeanings.en: to copy someone's behaviour because you admire them
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Children often imitate their parents.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Çocuklar genellikle ebeveynlerini örnek alır.

extraMeanings.en: an official meeting where facts are presented and a decision is made
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The court hearing is scheduled for next Monday.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Mahkeme duruşması gelecek pazartesi olarak planlandı.

extraMeanings.en: relating to a home and the people in it
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Household chores can take up a lot of time.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Ev işleri çok zaman alabilir.

extraMeanings.en: to weaken or damage an ability or quality
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Alcohol can seriously impair your judgment.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Alkol muhakeme yeteneğini ciddi şekilde bozabilir.
